headline: Narjust Florez: Cancer care for young adults must go beyond survival
dek: Posting live from the Young Lung Cancer Forum, the thoracic oncologist said a talk by Dr Cristina Pozo-Kaderman highlighted the mental health challenges young adults with cancer face.
body:
Narjust Florez, a thoracic medical oncologist, wrote on X on 21 November that she was attending the Young Lung Cancer Forum. She posted live from the event.

According to Florez, Dr Cristina Pozo-Kaderman spoke about the mental health challenges that are specific to young adults with cancer. Florez listed identity, relationships, fertility and career goals among the areas covered.

Florez opened her post by asking what happens when cancer interrupts the years in which people are expected to be building their future. She concluded: "Cancer care must go beyond survival." The post tagged Dana-Farber and Young Lung Cancer.
key_quote: Cancer care must go beyond survival.
